plan_changed.subject: Your HOLS plan is now {{plan_name}}
plan_changed.preheader: You switched from {{previous_plan_name}} to {{plan_name}}. Access is active through {{end_date}}.
plan_changed.headline: Your membership
plan_changed.body: Your HOLS membership is now {{plan_name}}. This replaces {{previous_plan_name}} and your new term starts immediately.
plan_changed.body_secondary: Review billing, renewal, and plan details anytime from Plans.
plan_changed.notice: New plan: {{plan_name}} · Previous: {{previous_plan_name}} · Charged: {{amount}} · Active through {{end_date}} · Order {{order_id}}
plan_changed.footer_note: If you did not request this change, contact support right away.

plan_change_failed.subject: We could not update your HOLS plan
plan_change_failed.preheader: Your switch from {{previous_plan_name}} to {{plan_name}} did not go through.
plan_change_failed.headline: Your plan change
plan_change_failed.body: We could not switch your membership from {{previous_plan_name}} to {{plan_name}}. Your current plan is unchanged.
plan_change_failed.body_secondary: Try the plan change again from Plans.
plan_change_failed.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

payment_success.subject: Payment received for your HOLS {{plan_name}} plan
payment_success.preheader: Your payment of {{amount}} for {{plan_name}} was successful. Order {{order_id}}.
payment_success.headline: Your payment
payment_success.body: Thank you. We received your payment of {{amount}} for the {{plan_name}} plan. Your membership is active.
payment_success.body_secondary: A receipt is saved in your order history. You can manage your plan from Plans.
payment_success.notice: Plan: {{plan_name}} · Amount: {{amount}} · Paid {{payment_date}} · Active through {{end_date}} · Order {{order_id}}
payment_success.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

payment_failed.subject: Your HOLS payment could not be completed
payment_failed.headline: Your payment
payment_failed.body: We could not complete your payment of {{amount}} for the {{plan_name}} plan. No charge was applied and your access was not updated.
payment_failed.body_secondary: Please try again from Plans. If the problem continues, contact support.
payment_failed.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

patient_recommendation_ready.subject: Peptide recommendation ready for {{patient_name}}
patient_recommendation_ready.headline: Recommendation ready
patient_recommendation_ready.body: The Peptide Advisor has a recommendation board for {{patient_name}}. Open the case to review the shortlist, safety notes, and consultation chat.
patient_recommendation_ready.body_secondary: These recommendations support clinical decision-making. They are not prescriptions. Apply professional judgment before acting.
patient_recommendation_ready.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

affiliate_account_created.subject: Your HOLS affiliate account
affiliate_account_created.preheader: Your HOLS affiliate account is ready. Sign in with the credentials in this email.
affiliate_account_created.headline: Your affiliate account
affiliate_account_created.body: Your HOLS affiliate account has been created. Use the details below to sign in.
affiliate_account_created.body_secondary: Please log in and change your password if required by your account policy.
affiliate_account_created.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

invite_to_join.subject: You are invited to join HOLS
invite_to_join.preheader: {{inviter_name}} invited you to create your HOLS account.
invite_to_join.headline: You're invited
invite_to_join.body: {{inviter_name}} invited you to join House of Life Sciences. Create your account with the button below.
invite_to_join.body_secondary: If you were not expecting this invite, you can ignore this email.
invite_to_join.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

affiliate_commission_earned.subject: You earned {{commission_amount}} from a HOLS referral
affiliate_commission_earned.headline: New commission
affiliate_commission_earned.body: {{student_name}} completed a {{plan_name}} purchase. Your affiliate commission of {{commission_amount}} has been added to your pending payout.
affiliate_commission_earned.body_secondary: Track commissions, pending payout, and customer orders anytime in Payout.
affiliate_commission_earned.notice: Student: {{student_name}} · Plan: {{plan_name}} · Order: {{amount}} · Commission: {{commission_amount}} ({{margin_percent}}) · Order {{order_id}} · Pending payout: {{pending_payout}}
affiliate_commission_earned.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

affiliate_payout_success.subject: Your HOLS payout of {{payout_amount}} was sent
affiliate_payout_success.headline: Your payout
affiliate_payout_success.body: We sent your affiliate payout of {{payout_amount}}. Funds should appear according to your payout method's processing time.
affiliate_payout_success.body_secondary: You can review this transfer and remaining pending earnings on your Payout page.
affiliate_payout_success.notice: Amount: {{payout_amount}} · Method: {{payout_method}} · Sent {{payout_date}} · Reference {{payout_id}} · Remaining pending: {{pending_payout}}
affiliate_payout_success.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

affiliate_payout_failed.subject: Your HOLS payout could not be completed
affiliate_payout_failed.headline: Your payout
affiliate_payout_failed.body: We could not complete your affiliate payout of {{payout_amount}}. The amount remains in your pending earnings.
affiliate_payout_failed.body_secondary: Please confirm your payout details, then try again or contact support if the issue continues.
affiliate_payout_failed.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

affiliate_payout_requested.subject: We received your HOLS payout request
affiliate_payout_requested.preheader: Your request for {{payout_amount}} is pending admin review.
affiliate_payout_requested.headline: Payout request
affiliate_payout_requested.body: Your payout request for {{payout_amount}} is in review. That amount has moved from available into pending until it is accepted or declined.
affiliate_payout_requested.body_secondary: You will get another email when the request is accepted or rejected.
affiliate_payout_requested.notice: Amount: {{payout_amount}} · Status: Pending review · Submitted {{requested_at}} · Reference {{payout_id}}
affiliate_payout_requested.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

affiliate_payout_rejected.subject: Your HOLS payout request was declined
affiliate_payout_rejected.preheader: {{payout_amount}} was returned to your available balance.
affiliate_payout_rejected.headline: Payout request
affiliate_payout_rejected.body: Your payout request for {{payout_amount}} was declined. The amount has been moved back to your available balance so you can request it again.
affiliate_payout_rejected.body_secondary: Review your payout details on the Payout page, or contact support if you need help.
affiliate_payout_rejected.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

affiliate_lock_released.subject: {{amount}} is now available to withdraw
affiliate_lock_released.preheader: Commission of {{amount}} moved from lock to your available balance.
affiliate_lock_released.headline: Locked earnings
affiliate_lock_released.body: {{amount}} in referral commission has finished its hold period and is now in your available balance.
affiliate_lock_released.body_secondary: You can request a payout from your available balance whenever you are ready.
affiliate_lock_released.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

affiliate_referral_order.subject: {{student_name}} placed a HOLS order
affiliate_referral_order.headline: Referral order
affiliate_referral_order.body: {{student_name}} just purchased the {{plan_name}} plan for {{amount}}. This order is tied to your affiliate account.
affiliate_referral_order.body_secondary: Your commission for this order is listed in a separate earnings email and on your Payout page.
affiliate_referral_order.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

student_order_placed.subject: Your HOLS {{plan_name}} order is confirmed
student_order_placed.headline: Your order
student_order_placed.body: Your {{plan_name}} order has been placed and confirmed. Membership access is active.
student_order_placed.body_secondary: You can review this order, invoices, and plan details from your account.
student_order_placed.notice: Plan: {{plan_name}} · Amount: {{amount}} · Placed {{order_date}} · Active through {{end_date}} · Order {{order_id}}
